tools.name: ghost_schema_freshness
tools.description: Has this published JSON Schema or OpenAPI document changed since a fingerprint you hold? The schema-drift recheck of the pre-spend policy: run it when a provider's published contract may have moved before you pay it again. Paid per call via x402; DSSE-signed receipt. tools.name: ghost_commerce_search
tools.description: Decide which x402 provider to pay, before paying it. Consult when the provider is unknown, when a decision you hold has passed its valid_until, or when the price, health, verdict or funding of one materially changed. Finds providers by need and ranks them by real economic evidence: independent payer

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ghost_pre_spend_gate" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
